question: How long (in years) will it take for ₹1,440 to become ₹2,700 at a rate of 10% per annum simple interest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Simple Interest generated = Amount − Principal = 2700 − 1440 = ₹1260.

Interest for 1 year = 10% of 1440 = ₹144.

Time taken = Total Interest ÷ Interest per year = 1260 ÷ 144.

Time = 35 ÷ 4 = 8.75 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 8.75 years.**
